Programming and analysis packages intentionally enlarge this profile's trusted computing base.
The defensive untrusted-system-code cell is a layered risk-reduction boundary, not a proof that guest escape is impossible.
The hostile guest intentionally permits guest-root administration; unprivileged QEMU refers only to the host-side QEMU process.
Read-only hostile payload ingress narrows data-transfer authority but does not make the sample, guest, hypervisor, or host safe.
A profile contract does not demonstrate that its runtime targets have been built or exercised.
The installed bubblewrap package is not evidence that the required outer host namespace was entered.

The ordinary hostile-kvm-cell evidence does not exercise payload ingress and cannot promote manifest.validation.hostile_payload_ingress; payload-ingress evidence cannot promote manifest.validation.hostile_kvm_cell.

The Internet probe supports only an artifact-bound single-endpoint reachability observation and does not establish network isolation, anonymity, containment, availability, release authority, or arbitrary-malware safety.

required_evidence_outputs is the exact canonical output set; missing hostile-cell and payload-ingress records keep their separate manifest validation fields NOT_MEASURED and leave the corresponding capabilities unclaimed.
